result.description: Metalwork WA Pty Ltd   Position Overview   Metalwork WA Pty Ltd is seeking a skilled and motivated Full-time Metal Fabricator to join its fabrication team in Western Australia. The successful applicant will fabricate, assemble, install, maintain, modify, and repair structural steel and other fabricated metal products by interpreting engineering drawings, preparing metal materials, and carrying out welding and fabrication activities while maintaining high standards of quality, precision, and workplace safety.    Key Responsibilities    Interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, specifications, and work instructions.  Mark out, measure, cut, shape, and prepare metal sections, plates, pipes, and structural components.  Fabricate, assemble, and install structural steel, frames, platforms, handrails, brackets, truck bodies, and other fabricated metal products.  Fit, align, and join fabricated metal components using appropriate welding processes and fabrication techniques in accordance with engineering specifications.   Operate fabrication equipment including guillotines, press brakes, rollers, drills, saws, grinders, and other workshop machinery.  Inspect fabricated products to ensure dimensional accuracy and compliance with quality standards and engineering specifications.  Repair, modify, and maintain metal structures and fabricated products as required.  Maintain a safe, clean, and organised work environment while complying with workplace health and safety policies and procedures.  Maintain fabrication equipment and tools in a safe operating condition and comply with workplace health and safety procedures throughout all fabrication activities.     Skills and Experience   The successful applicant should possess:   A qualification relevant to metal fabrication, engineering fabrication, boilermaking, welding, or a closely related trade equivalent to AQF Certificate III including at least two years of on-the-job training, or AQF Certificate IV (ANZSCO Skill Level 3).  Demonstrated ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, fabrication plans, and technical specifications.  Experience in fabricating, assembling, fitting, installing, modifying, and repairing structural steel and fabricated metal products.   Competency in welding and the safe operation of fabrication machinery and associated hand and power tools.  Strong knowledge of metalworking techniques, measuring equipment, quality control processes, and workplace health and safety requirements.  Good communication skills, attention to detail, problem-solving ability, and the capacity to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.    What We Offer    Full-time permanent employment with an established Western Australian steel fabrication company.  Competitive remuneration commensurate with skills and experience.  Opportunity to work on diverse commercial, industrial, mining, and infrastructure fabrication projects.  A professional and safety-focused workplace with modern fabrication equipment.  Ongoing opportunities to develop technical skills and contribute to high-quality fabrication projects.  Supportive team environment with a commitment to quality workmanship and continuous improvement.    Application Process   Applicants must submit a resume and a cover letter outlining relevant experience and suitability for the role.  Metalwork WA Pty Ltd is an equal opportunity employer and supports a diverse workforce.  About Company     METALWORK WA PTY LTD  is a Western Australian steel fabrication company specialising in truck body building, structural steel, and architectural steel fabrication. The company provides end-to-end fabrication services, including design, drafting, manufacturing, blasting, painting, and on-site installation for commercial, industrial, construction, and mining clients. Operating from a fully equipped workshop in Perth, Metalwork WA delivers custom metal fabrication solutions, site welding, and steel construction projects while maintaining a strong commitment to quality, workplace safety, and timely project delivery. The company has been actively operating in Australia since 2009 as a registered Australian proprietary company. result.description:
Lead reliability at one of Australia's largest food manufacturing facilities!

At JBS Dinmore, the largest and most respected beef processing plants in the southern hemisphere, we are seeking an experienced Maintenance Superintendent to join our Maintenance Leadership Team.

Reporting to the Engineering Manager, you will be responsible for overseeing all maintenance activities within the abattoir, ensuring equipment reliability, compliance with WHS standards, and minimal downtime. This role manages maintenance teams, coordinates preventive and corrective maintenance, and supports continuous improvement initiatives to optimise plant performance This is a full-time role with annual salary higher than $120,000 plus Superannuation.

Key Responsibilities

· Plan, schedule, and supervise preventive and corrective maintenance activities.

· Ensure compliance with WHS, environmental, and food safety standards during maintenance operations.

· Manage maintenance team performance, rosters, and resource allocation.

· Monitor equipment reliability and implement strategies to reduce downtime.

· Coordinate with Production, QA, and Engineering to resolve technical issues promptly.

· Maintain accurate records of maintenance activities, spare parts usage, and equipment history.

· Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance maintenance efficiency and cost-effectiveness.

· Ensure compliance with statutory inspections and regulatory requirements.

· Support capital projects and installation of new equipment.

· Encourage open communication so staff feel comfortable reporting hazards, equipment issues, or training needs.

· Reinforce teamwork between maintenance, operations, and QA, helping everyone understand the impact of their role on plant performance and food safety.

· Serve as a trusted point of contact for technical questions, offering approachable and supportive guidance.

· Additional tasks as requested by your supervisor or management.

About You

· Extensive experience in industrial maintenance within food processing or manufacturing.

· Strong knowledge of mechanical, electrical, and refrigeration systems.

· Understanding of WHS, environmental, and food safety compliance.

· Leadership and team management skills.

· Ability to analyse data and implement reliability improvement strategies.

· Trade qualification or engineering degree.

· Experience with CMMS (Computerised Maintenance Management Systems).

· Knowledge of Lean or continuous improvement methodologies.

Why Join JBS?

Leadership opportunity within Australia's largest food manufacturer
Influence reliability and maintenance strategy across a major production facility
Work with large-scale industrial equipment and modern automation systems
Ongoing professional development and career progression opportunities
Supportive leadership team and stable, long-term employment
If you're an experienced electrical leader ready to make a significant impact in a complex manufacturing environment, we'd love to hear from you.

The Ad is valid for 28 days.

Apply now and help drive operational excellence at JBS Dinmore.

Your new role  In this position, you will be based in the workshop, completing high-quality fabrication, welding, and assembly work. Join a highly respected Australian defence technology organisation delivering complex engineering programs that support critical national capabilities. With a strong focus on innovation and project excellence, this organisation offers the opportunity to contribute to the delivery of sophisticated, software-intensive systems within a highly collaborative environment.  
  Role Description     
  As the Configuration Management Officer, you will be responsible for planning, executing, and maintaining CM activities across the full project lifecycle. Acting as the primary point of contact for CM-related matters, you will ensure configuration control processes are effectively implemented and maintained while supporting engineering, project, and IT teams.  
  Key Responsibilities  
 
  Execute and maintain CM activities across all project stages, recording and maintaining product hierarchies and identifiers within baseline documentation.  
  Act as Secretary to the Configuration Control Board (CCB), circulating paperwork, scheduling meetings, and ensuring change processes are successfully completed.  
  Maintain a detailed inventory of assets, including operating system versions, patch statuses, and installed applications.  
  Collaborate with IT and administration staff to maintain and improve the CM system, including library environments, access privileges, and backups.  
  Establish requirements for supplier delivery of data products, document timely receipts, and assess data acceptability.  
  Perform physical and functional audits of systems and software to verify compliance with established baselines, providing input to the Quality Manager.  
 
  Key Skills & Attributes  
 
  Configuration & Data Management: Deep functional knowledge of CM and Data Management principles and their associated tools.  
  IT & Engineering Acumen: Proficiency in IT combined with a solid understanding of project and engineering management lifecycles.  
  Analytical Problem-Solving: A structured and analytical approach to problem identification and resolution.  
  Meticulous Precision: Exceptional attention to detail when planning and performing all configuration tasks.  
  Communication & Collaboration: The ability to communicate clearly and concisely, working effectively on your own, within the team, and with external agencies or subcontractors.  
 
  Qualifications & Experience  
 
  Security Clearance: Must hold an active NV1 Australian Defence security clearance or have the ability to obtain one.  
  Experience: 2+ years of experience using mature/commercial CM tools within an engineering lifecycle environment.  
  Technical Exposure: 2+ years of experience supporting the delivery of complex systems containing software.  
  Education: A Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, IT, or a related field is highly regarded, alongside prior Defence Industry experience.  
 
  Why Join?   Secure a rewarding opportunity to work on complex Defence projects within a supportive and technically focused environment. You will have the chance to further develop your Configuration Management expertise while contributing to critical sovereign capability programs.  
  How to Apply  
  If you have the experience to execute these critical CM functions and meet the security requirements, please apply now with your updated resume.  
 If this role sounds enticing to you, please do not hesitate to apply now or send Rohan an email at Rohan.cantleysmith@randstad.com.au.
